lean.statement: For every finite-dimensional complete real inner-product Borel space E, every potential U:E→ℝ, alpha and eta in NNReal with 0<alpha<=1, U in C², alpha*‖v‖² <= fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ U) x v v <= ‖v‖² for all x,v, every p,xref in E with gradient U p=0 and ‖gradient U xref‖² <= alpha*finrank ℝ E, and eta<=1: let μ=(volume:Measure E).tilted (fun x=>-U x), piEta=gaussianSmoothing μ (Real.sqrt eta); PhaseMetric.phaseWassersteinSq (1/alpha) ((Measure.dirac xref).prod (stdGaussian E)) (piEta.prod (stdGaussian E)) <= ENNReal.ofReal (5*(1/alpha)*finrank ℝ E).
approved_definition_context: E is a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product Borel space, with volume and standard Gaussian measures.
The phase transport quantity is a squared Kantorovich infimum for the paper's M_kappa quadratic cost; the target law uses a tilted volume measure, Gaussian smoothing, and product Gaussian momentum.
